data.narrative:
Mbodi AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Xavier Chi and Sebastian Peralta that has raised $4.4M to date. The robotics and manufacturing sector comprises a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company, though the Seed-stage subset is limited.

Given the thinness of direct Seed-stage peers in robotics and manufacturing, the peer-median method is not applicable—only one same-stage comparable was identified, falling short of the minimum three datapoints needed for reliable triangulation. Consequently, the valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $4.4M capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $11M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $9M (low) to $13M (high), centered on a $11M median. The key uncertainty is the absence of sufficient same-stage comparables in the narrow sector, which limits the ability to validate the 2.5x multiplier through peer benchmarking. Any refinement of this range would require additional Seed-stage robotics transactions or clarity on Mbodi AI's specific subsector positioning relative to the available peer set.
